description: This file defines the BuzzService class within the OrangeHRM platform, responsible for managing operations related toBuzz posts and comments, including permission checks. It interacts with Data Access Objects (DAOs) and utilizes traits for user role management.

classes.name: BuzzService
classes.description: Service class providing permission management and data retrieval for Buzz posts and comments in the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getBuzzDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of BuzzDao.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of BuzzLikeDao.

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Determines if the current user can update a specific Buzz feed post based on permissions.

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Determines if the current user can delete a specific Buzz feed post based on permissions.

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to update a specific Buzz comment.

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to delete a specific Buzz comment.
